claim: Marking a missed block produces a revised plan and a list of deadlines at risk.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; capture the seeded receipt, schedule, and risk; miss the next block; assert all three outcomes update

claim: Copies the current reschedule receipt to the clipboard.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; copy the sample receipt and assert the clipboard contains its missed work and risk details

claim: Downloads the current reschedule receipt as a text file.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; download the sample receipt and assert the text file name and receipt content

claim: You can delete assignments from the planner.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; confirm deletion of a sample assignment and assert it is removed while its existing receipt keeps the assignment name

claim: Imports timed events from an ICS calendar as unavailable time.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a fixed clock; upload the shipped two-event fixture and assert every resulting study block avoids both event ranges

claim: Exports the local plan as a JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh browser context; download the backup and parse its required arrays

claim: Imports a JSON backup into the local plan.
sandbox: fresh demo; export distinctive assignment, calendar, settings, and receipt values; enter an empty real plan; import and assert every value is restored

claim: Demo sample data stays in memory and is not saved into a real plan.
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1, reset and reschedule it, inspect IndexedDB, then start for real and assert the real plan is empty

claim: Planning data stays in this browser. The app uses no analytics, external fonts, or externally hosted page assets.
sandbox: fresh browser context; cover landing, complete demo, and real add/calendar/import/export flows; assert exact request paths, same origin, and no beacons

claim: The complete rescheduler is free for four active assignments.
sandbox: fresh browser context; add four assignments, assert all plan, then assert the fifth is declined with the stated limit

claim: Unlimited active assignments and receipt history cost $9 once through Sociobot checkout.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert price and checkout URL, mock a valid license, plan five assignments, and assert a second receipt enters history

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; wait for service worker control, set the context offline, reload, and assert the planner and offline state

claim: Estimates change only when the student chooses a trim.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert a missed block leaves a sample estimate unchanged, then choose Trim 30 min and assert that estimate changes by 30 minutes

claim: Rough estimates stay marked in a receipt for review.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert a sample rough estimate and its receipt review label are visible

claim: Real plans are stored in this browser’s IndexedDB database.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /planner; add an assignment, reload, and inspect IndexedDB for deadline-reality-check:real

claim: License checks send the stored token to the Sociobot billing API.
sandbox: fresh browser context; accept a license URL, record the mocked verifier request, and assert its Sociobot origin, GET method, query token, and empty request body

claim: Checkout opens on Dodo through Sociobot.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the terms wording, request the Sociobot checkout URL without following redirects, and verify its Dodo checkout host
